title: Choosing from triples, non-divisible sum
prompt: Specification: solve(triples, k) chooses exactly one number from each triple, returns the maximum achievable sum that is not divisible by k, and assumes that at least one such choice exists. Select the implementation that satisfies the specification.

evidence.title: Execution results for each candidate
evidence.body: Each candidate was executed on two inputs. Expected results follow the specification.

recommendation.text: Implementation A is correct. Replacing the maximum with the second maximum is the smallest possible loss, so the resulting sum is maximal.

annotations.notes: Frozen Qwen3-8B sample answered B (correct). Structured recommendation perturbed to A to obtain an incorrect recommendation; exclude in sensitivity analysis. Difficulty reclassified from low to high for bank balance.
